title: Convergence Master Unified Sensory Dictionary (SSOT)
description: Single authoritative dictionary of sensory terms, irregular English inflections, and cross-thematic applications.

themes_registry.core: Universal human sensory baseline (perceptible in any era or genre)
themes_registry.cozy_hearth: Domestic warmth, kitchen hearths, hearty food, baking, woodwork, herbal teas
themes_registry.industrial_foundry: Blast furnaces, steam power, cogs, machine grease, pneumatic pistons, slag
themes_registry.grimdark_military: Battlefield aftermath, cold mud, gangrene, copper blood, wounded triage
themes_registry.high_fantasy: Aetheric flows, crystal chimes, runes, celestial light, sacred incense
themes_registry.cyberpunk_scifi: Neon ozone, neural coolant, synthetic polymers, chrome, electronic glare
themes_registry.fantasy_industrial: Blend of aetheric magic, locomotive mechanics, and frontier grit
